edges.method: 10-point local-outward-normal circle fit on the exported STL's Z=0.001mm cross-section (STAND_BASE_PLANE is an ellipse-like curve, not a true circle -- see cradle_model.py KEEL_R comment); each sample casts a horizontal ray outward-then-inward along that point's own boundary-tangent-derived normal, at 0.015mm Z steps from 0 to 0.45mm, and fits a circle to the resulting (projected-distance, Z) profile

6-point circle fit (3 azimuths x 2 clear arcs at 138.5/318.5 deg -- the only 2 of the 4 clear wall arcs with NO lip finger in them; the other 2, 41.5/221.5 deg, are the lip-finger footprints themselves and no longer carry this plain-wall edge) at radius=POCKET_BORE_R, varying local Z' from POCKET_DEPTH-0.8 to POCKET_DEPTH, horizontal ray cast outward from near the pocket axis

Same horizontal-ray/circle-fit method as E-01/E-02, targeted at each lip finger's outer-top corner (r=WALL_OD_R, z'=POCKET_DEPTH). NO SAMPLES: the fillet operation (attempted both before and after the finger's union into the assembled body, at radii from 1.2mm down to 0.3mm) failed OCC's fillet solver on this specific compound edge every time (BRep_API: command not done, or a completed-but-invalid result) -- see candidate_readiness.md/print_notes.md for the full attempted-radius log. The exported geometry ships with a SHARP (unfilleted) top-outer corner on both lip fingers.

Circle fit at each lip finger's inner boundary edge (r=lip_r_inner, z'=POCKET_DEPTH-LIP_HEIGHT), horizontal ray varying local Z' from lip_z0-0.05 to lip_z0+0.6; 2 sample azimuths per finger (near each end of its 24deg arc), 2 fingers = 4 samples
